svg.text: WICK SHOWN x4 THICKNESS FOR CLARITY
Port sits inside the pocket footprint, clear of posts by 2.0 min.
Pinch off, cold-weld, then laser seal the tip. Do NOT use a screw seal.
MATL: OXYGEN-FREE copper C10200 / JIS C1020, annealed, 1.0 sheet.
NOT tough-pitch C1100 - see VC-101 note 1.
Wick clearance holes keep post lands bare for metal-to-metal
Braze tube before bake-out, after diffusion bonding.
Handle with gloves. No hydrocarbons on bond faces.
Cu C10200 OFHC (JIS C1020) / 68 x 68 x 1.0 / WICK-LINED, FILL PORT
